description: Local-first AI desktop app for meeting notes, transcription, and summaries.
pre_install: if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $payload -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Yogurt application payload archive was not found in the NSIS package.' }
if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $mainExe -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Yogurt.exe was not found after extracting the nested application archive.' }
notes: Meeting data, recordings, settings, and local models are stored under %APPDATA%\Yogurt, outside the Scoop app directory.
